Sketchy
Nov 2016
We stopped in to grab a few cocktails and from the beginning our server was not upfront with us. He told my wife that one of the cocktails was probably "too strong" for a girl but we laughed and she ordered it anyway. After offering us weed and laughing gas we got suspicious and asked what all the cocktails contained. After about a minute of pressing him for more info finally he said the cocktails come with alcohol and some "special happy ingredient" but wouldn't say what. That's when we left. He was friendly, decor was nice but overall just not the kind of place we were into. 

I understand why he thought that would appeal to most young travelers, but I didn't appreciate that he wasn't straightforward with us from the beginning or at least offer to make cocktails without any "secret ingredients".
